ablation.label: A4c + conflict-aware placement table for master chunks (persistent, decided at write time)

di_write_filter: master-side score writes at D_i dropped against the per-agent bitmap; diff/master arrival order immaterial
die_tlb_accounting: dependency-only; no extra latency or energy beyond AttAcc

overlap_validation.contract: AttAcc comm_x2g busy timeline plus explicit CacheBlend resources

tlb.head_mapping: head h uses channel_base + ((channel_offset + h) % channel_count); after channel_count heads, advance by one 8-KiB partition (implemented by the Ramulator trace generator, --pool-base)
tlb.layout: A4e: per-head diff row as A4c; master chunks on a persistent conflict-aware slot table (Fugue sec. 4), decided at write time
tlb.scan: each pool is streamed sequentially; a diff entry's shadow_master row is read in the master stream and masked out of the score (event masked_rows)
